strategies.name: Baseline 8-stage sequential all-reduce

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then allgather per stage
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with reduce-scatter (producing S-sized local shard) followed by allgather to reconstruct full vector. 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage). Trades dispatch count for potentially better network utilization via scatter-gather pattern, especially beneficial at world_size=224.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduce within nodes
strategies.desc: Exploit num_nodes structure by first doing node-local all-reduce (cheaper intra-node bandwidth), then inter-node all-reduce on node-representative results, then broadcast back within nodes. ~24 dispatches (3 per stage). Optimizes for multi-node topology by reducing cross-node traffic.

strategies.name: Pipelined chunked micro-batching across stages
strategies.desc: Split the W*S tensor into chunks and pipeline them through the 8 stages, starting stage i+1 on chunk k while stage i processes chunk k+1. Overlaps communication with local computation across stages. Dispatch count remains ~8 but with smaller per-dispatch payloads and better latency hiding.

strategies.name: Fused local-op with async collectives
strategies.desc:
Use async all-reduce variants (if available) to issue all 8 collectives back-to-back, overlapping the bidiagonal coupling/uncoupling computation with in-flight communication. 8 async dispatches with wait barriers only at data dependencies. Hides local compute latency behind network transfers.
